summary: This Goodful video surveys a playful sequence of vegan recipes built around accessible, affordable ingredients and flavorful techniques. It starts by roasting garlic to intensify its aroma, then demonstrates a dairy-free oat-milk base for a mac and cheese sauce thickened with cornstarch and enriched with miso-like flavors from nutritional yeast, tomato paste, and a peppery pepper-roasted component. The chef then crafts a vegan ricotta from cashews, transitions to a meatless (wine-based) tomato sauce, and assembles a baked elbow Mac with cheese layers. Interleaved are demonstrations of black rice sushi rolls with toasted nori, a miso-sesame dipping sauce, a hummus-forward appetizer with grilled veggies, and a butter–Chardonnay sauce featuring morel mushrooms. The video closes with a dessert-laden plate featuring a pecan-date crust and lemon sorbet. Throughout, cost-conscious substitutions (bouillon cubes for broth, jarred peppers) and kid-friendly, hands-on steps are emphasized, with a few playful host asides woven in.

sections.title: Roasting garlic to concentrate flavor
sections.description: Garlic is roasted to concentrate its flavor, aiming for a robust garlicky note to elevate the mac and cheese.

sections.title: Oven temperature and timing for roasting
sections.description: Instructs setting the oven to 400F (200C) and roasting for about 35–40 minutes.

sections.title: Making oat milk base

sections.title: Straining oat milk (first pass)
sections.description: Demonstrates straining the blended oat mixture to achieve a smooth liquid.

sections.title: Sautéing shallots and seasoning
sections.description: Shallots are sautéed to layer oniony, garlicky flavor for the sauce.

sections.title: Adding roasted garlic into the blender
sections.description: Roasted garlic is squeezed and added to the blender for the sauce base.

sections.title: Incorporating roasted red pepper
sections.description: Half a roasted red pepper is added to boost flavor and color while keeping costs down.

sections.title: Spices and dairy-free flavor boosters
sections.description: Seasoning components to emulate cheesy, vibrant flavors without dairy.

sections.title: Liquids and thickening agents for sauce
sections.description: Adds cornstarch for thickening, vegetable broth for body, vinegar and tomato paste for brightness and depth, and oat milk for creaminess.

sections.title: Blending the vegan sauce base
sections.description: All sauce components are blended to form a smooth base.

sections.title: Cooking and thickening the sauce on the stove
sections.description: Sauce is transferred to a pot and simmered to develop thickness and cohesion.

sections.title: Pasta choice and coating

sections.title: Vegan ricotta from cashews
sections.description: Cashews are blended with lemon, olive oil, basil, garlic, and water to create a dairy-free ricotta.

sections.title: Vegan meat sauce foundation

sections.title: Assembly and bake of vegan mac

sections.title: Intro to black rice sushi rolls

sections.title: Sushi rolling technique and materials

sections.title: Miso-sesame dipping sauce
sections.description: A dipping sauce combining miso, sesame, maple, lemon, and optional ginger for heat.

sections.title: Appetizer prep: hummus and grilled veggies
sections.description: Roasted/grilled vegetables paired with hummus and naan, finished with flavor touches like olives and truffle oil.

sections.title: Entree: butter Chardonnay sauce with Morel mushrooms

sections.title: Dessert prep: pecan-date crust and sorbet finish
